explanation: The negation of the Pompeiu conjecture (an admissible domain without the Pompeiu property must be a ball) in the plane. Admissible domains are bounded, open, connected, simply connected, with Lipschitz boundary. It is tagged solved citing 2026 counterexamples (Cao-Labora–de Dios Pont, with a linked Lean proof; Colbrook–Stepaniants). The statement is well formed. I did not verify these very recent results.
